remarks: Experience exceptional Westport living at 282 North Avenue, a beautifully maintained estate set on over 2 private acres just minutes from downtown, beaches, top-rated schools, and Metro-North access to NYC. Offering nearly 8,000 square feet of living space, this impressive 7-bedroom, 8+ bath residence blends classic New England architecture with expansive, light-filled interiors designed for both everyday living and elegant entertaining. Sun-filled rooms, hardwood floors, and oversized windows create a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. The spacious kitchen offers abundant cabinetry and prep space while opening to generous dining and living areas ideal for gatherings. Multiple flexible living spaces allow for home offices, guest accommodations, recreation rooms, or wellness areas to suit today's lifestyle. The beautifully landscaped grounds provide privacy and open outdoor space perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Located in one of Westport's most desirable areas, this home offers convenient access to vibrant downtown restaurants, shopping, beaches, and commuter routes. Flexible lease may be considered. A rare opportunity to enjoy the scale, privacy, and lifestyle of a premier Westport property.
